correctness.rationale: For all n≥3 with equal last signs, the exact one-sided endpoint table forces branch slope n or n−1 and all switching targets inside every image. Exact stationary weights are positive and solve every finite Markov balance equation. The partition cylinders give a Markov branch process, with strong two-state lumpability and an explicit eigenvalue κ/[n(n−1)]; the covariance, CLT, and entropy follow. A Perron eigenvector contradiction proves strict gap for κ>0 and a uniform Taylor expansion gives θ(1−θ)/2. Independent exact rational checks across 2044 words support the argument but are not infinite proofs.
